design_archetype: Xianxia Dark Fantasy / Ancient Gu Cultivation
theme_philosophy: Deep Obsidian Void combined with Jade Spirit Glow and Crimson Blood Gu accents. Atmospheric, mystical, ruthless, and distraction-free reader experience inspired by LOTM and ORV readers.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach. Default layout tailored for mobile touch screens (360px+), scaling gracefully to tablets (768px+) and desktop widescreen (1280px+).
responsive.layout: Single-column stacked view on mobile. Dynamic side drawers for Table of Contents and Settings on mobile/tablet, expanding into collapsible sidebars on desktop. Floating bottom reader action bar for one-handed mobile reading.
responsive.typography: Mobile base size 16px (1rem) for body reading to avoid auto-zoom on inputs; headings fluidly scale from 1.75rem on mobile to 3rem on desktop using clamp() functions.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root and container elements; reader text container constrained with max-w-[65ch] to max-w-[100ch] dependent on reader width settings.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px touch target sizes for mobile reader navigation buttons, font size modifiers, and chapter navigation controls.

visual_enhancers.border_styles: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) with subtle hover glow
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle ink noise texture background, ancient seal icons, jade stone borders

landing_page.hero_layout: Grid split: Left column (Hero Title, Novel Badges, Quick Stats [2334+ Chapters, 5/5 Rank, Completed], Synopsis, Continue Reading CTA), Right column (3D-effect Book Cover with Jade Aura)
landing_page.stats_grid: 4-column metric grid (Chapters Read, Total Words, Cultivation Rank, Community Rating)
landing_page.feature_highlights: 3-column bento card grid showcasing Reader Features (Distraction Free, Offline Progress, Custom Themes, Quick Bookmark)

table_of_contents.search_bar: Sticky search + filter bar (Search chapter # or title, Filter: All / Unread / Read / Bookmarked, Volume selector dropdown)
table_of_contents.chapter_grid: Grid 1-col on mobile, 2-col on md, 3-col on lg with compact chapter cards showing Chapter #, Title, Reading status indicator, Bookmark toggle, Last read timestamp

reader_view.structure: Fixed Header with Progress Bar, Collapsible ToC Drawer on Left, Floating/Sticky Settings Modal on Right, Main Centered Reading Column (Width adjustable: 600px, 800px, 1000px, Full)
reader_view.bottom_navigation: Sticky/Floating bottom toolbar on mobile with Prev Chapter, Next Chapter, Settings, Bookmark, ToC, Scroll to Top

key_features.novel_cover_page: Rich landing view with Reverend Insanity introduction, Fang Yuan quote, tags (Cultivation, Dark Fantasy, Anti-Hero, Time Travel, Gu Refining), volume breakdown
key_features.chapter_reader: Fast client-side chapter loading with smooth scroll restoration, page progress indicator, chapter title sticky header, estimated reading time indicator
key_features.reading_settings: Comprehensive customization modal: Font Family (Serif, Sans, Mono), Font Size (12px to 32px), Line Height (1.2 to 2.2), Letter Spacing, Container Width (Narrow/Medium/Wide/Full), Theme Switcher (Dark, Sepia, Light, Black), Auto-Scroll Mode with speed control
key_features.bookmark_system: Save specific chapters with optional custom notes or highlighted quotes stored in LocalStorage, managed from a dedicated Bookmarks Page
key_features.progress_tracking: Automatic saving of last read chapter, scroll position offset percentage, chapter completion status (unread/in-progress/read)
key_features.table_of_contents_drawer: Quick-access slide-out panel while reading to jump to any chapter instantly without losing state
key_features.search_and_filter: Instant search by chapter number or title, volume sorting, filter read/unread/bookmarked
key_features.keyboard_shortcuts: Arrow Right / J (Next Chapter), Arrow Left / K (Prev Chapter), B (Bookmark), S (Settings), T (Table of Contents), F (Toggle Full Width), ? (Shortcut Menu Modal)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure all interactive components have `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='continue-reading-btn'`, `data-testid='chapter-search-input'`, `data-testid='theme-selector-dark'`, `data-testid='reader-font-size-increase'`, `data-testid='bookmark-toggle-btn'`).

2. Implement LocalStorage persistence for: lastReadChapter, readingProgress (object mapping chapterId -> scrollPosition percentage & completed status), bookmarks (array of chapter details and optional notes), readerSettings (theme, fontFamily, fontSize, lineHeight, containerWidth, autoScrollSpeed).

3. Provide rich sample chapter data (at least 20-30 fully fleshed out chapters of Reverend Insanity with realistic cultivation content and volume groupings) or dynamic EPUB/JSON loader if local EPUB file is present.
4. Ensure non-transparent backgrounds on all dropdowns, modals, and sticky headers to prevent content bleed-through.
5. Make sure the mobile UI includes a sticky bottom reader bar with easy touch controls for chapter navigation, settings, and drawer toggles.
6. Include a Keyboard Shortcuts cheatsheet modal triggered by '?' or a header shortcut icon.
7. Implement smooth scroll restoration when reopening a chapter so the reader resumes exactly where they left off.
8. Use Sonner toasts for bookmark actions, settings resets, and progress notifications.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_purity: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout_alignment: You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.button_styles: Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp Xianxia bordered buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_emojis: NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons or custom SVG symbols.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use `sonner` for toasts located at `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx` or installed sonner package.
